components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that advances the current task.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; background: #1f5fb8; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(31,95,184,0.22); font-family: Inter, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2269dc; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9dc3ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action that stays available without competing.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid #e7ecf4; border-radius: 9px; background: #f4f7fb; color: #5e6c82; font-family: Inter, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #edf2fa; color: #274b78; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9dc3ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Low-chrome input for a single operational value.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid #dfe6f0; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #263448; font-family: Inter, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #93bdf7; outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47,124,246,0.1); }

components.name: Working Card
components.html:
文件列表

已在这台电脑上的文件，可以保存到下载目录或删除。

components.name: Online Status Pill
components.description: A compact semantic status with a leading signal dot.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e9f9f1; color: #0b7a49; font-family: Inter, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-status::before { content: ''; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Quiet primary navigation with a clear active surface.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: #6d788a; font-family: Inter, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav:hover { background: #f5f7fb; color: #1b2533; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9dc3ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav.is-active { background: #eaf2ff; color: #2f7cf6; }

components.name: Mode Switch
components.description: A two-mode segmented control with a light active lift.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: flex; width: 100%; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid #e0e6ef; border-radius: 11px; background: #e9edf5; } .ds-switch-tab { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #69758a; font-family: Inter, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch-tab.is-active { background: #fff; color: #1d2a3e; box-shadow: 0 2px 7px rgba(35,55,90,0.09); } .ds-switch-tab em { margin-left: 4px; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff0d7; color: #b57512; font-size: 0.62rem; font-style: normal; }

components.name: Public Pause Card
components.description: A calm safety state; not a service-failure alert.
components.html:
NETWORK PAUSED

当前网络为公用网络，局域网传输服务已暂停。

切换到专用网络后将自动恢复，不会在 Public 网络开放 42080/42081。
components.css: .ds-pause { max-width: 760px; padding: 26px 28px; border: 1px solid #e6eaf1; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(35,55,90,0.04); } .ds-pause-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 5px; color: #2f7cf6; font-family: Inter, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.13em; } .ds-pause h2 { margin: 6px 0 8px; color: #253246; font-family: Cambria, 'Microsoft YaHei', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.45; font-weight: 700; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-pause p { margin: 0; color: #64748b; font-family: Inter, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.7; } .ds-pause-action { margin-top: 16px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; background: #1f5fb8; color: #fff; font-family: Inter, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }

narrative.overview:
Filebridge-Lan should feel like a well-kept local workbench: the files, devices, connection state, and next action are visible without ceremony. It is an Operate surface, not a marketing surface. Density is moderate, hierarchy is carried by grouping and spacing, and the blue signal appears where the user can act or needs to notice a state.

The interface is calm and precise rather than expressive. White working surfaces sit on a cool, low-contrast canvas; borders do most of the separation, with shadows only supplying a soft sense of lift. The emotional promise is trust: the user should be able to tell what is local, what is paused, what is connected, and what will happen next.

The visual identity now has a deliberate two-voice relationship. A serif voice—Cambria on Windows—marks the product name and the most important headings; the working language stays in a neutral system sans, with Microsoft YaHei for Chinese and Inter for English body and compact data. The serif is a signature, not a global skin.
keyCharacteristics: Cool light canvas, white task cards, thin cool-gray borders.
Signal Blue reserved for action, active navigation, links, and current state.
Serif brand voice against a neutral, highly legible working sans.
Soft, low-offset elevation; never heavy floating panels.
Dense operational controls with generous grouping space.
Safety states read as calm system states, not generic errors.
Touch targets stay at least 44px and narrow screens use icon-only navigation.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue marks an action or a live state; it does not decorate cards, headings, or backgrounds. If everything is blue, nothing is a signal.

rules.name: The Calm Fault Rule
rules.body: Red is for a fault the user can act on. A Public-network pause is a calm warning state, not a red error.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Cambria is for the product name, the page title, and a small number of emphasis headings only. Body copy, buttons, labels, statuses, and file rows stay in the neutral working sans.

rules.name: The Chinese Fallback Rule
rules.body: Never force Cambria onto Chinese glyphs. Chinese headings and body text resolve through Microsoft YaHei (or the platform CJK sans fallback), preserving native readability.

rules.name: The Dense Data Rule
rules.body: Compact data uses Inter or monospace with lining tabular numerals; do not use proportional serif figures inside dense status rows.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: At rest, separation comes from the hairline border and tonal surface difference. A shadow is a soft secondary cue, not the primary container edge.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: No backdrop blur, translucent glass panels, or neon halos. Depth belongs to the light material system already present.

dos: Do keep the sidebar at 208px and the working content single-column; the task reads top to bottom.
Do use Signal Blue only for primary actions, active navigation, links, and current-state emphasis.
Do use Cambria for the product name, page title, and a small number of emphasis headings; let Chinese fall through to Microsoft YaHei.
Do keep body and operational controls in the neutral sans stack; use Inter for English body and compact data.
Do use 16px cards, one-pixel hairlines, and the existing soft shadow rather than adding a new elevation level.
Do distinguish Public pause, service fault, and unavailable host with different copy and color semantics.
Do let text wrap with text-wrap: balance on headings and keep the 390px layout free of horizontal scroll.
donts: Don't set Cambria on body copy, buttons, labels, statuses, or file lists; the serif is a signature, not the interface voice.
Don't introduce a second accent color or use blue as a decorative wash.
Don't use glass, blur, neon halos, gradient text, or heavy floating shadows.
Don't use thick colored side borders, zero-blur hard shadows, or nested cards as a layout strategy.
Don't make a safety pause look like a crash or an app-not-started error.
Don't hide the current connectability behind a bare "paired" label.
